editorialSummary: While world diplomats [tanked climate talks](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/25/cop31-collapse-must-be-a-catalyst-for-genuine-climate-action) and Moscow prepared [space-based nukes](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/11/25/risk-of-russia-launching-a-nuclear-weapon-into-space-within-two-months-deemed-serious_6788608_4.html), the press stayed fixated on [Delta’s router failures](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/epoca/noticia/2026/11/25/investigadores-reproduzem-falha-que-suspendeu-voos-nos-eua-e-apontam-possivel-problema-em-roteador-veja-o-que-se-sabe.ghtml). At least the long-extinct [American chestnut tree](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/24/american-chestnut-tree-restored-science-persistence-aoe) is finally returning to watch the rest of us expire in silence.
